title: reliquary machine state
description: Synchronized companion to the instance model (instance-model.md), which remains normative. Describes reliquary-machine.json — the per-machine state document reliquary writes under cache/machines/<id>/. reliquary authors this file (canonical strict JSON, no comments); the schema documents the recorded-output contract for consumers reading it out-of-band. Schema validity never implies a live, consistent machine: identity verification, lifecycle reconciliation, media re-verification, and the blueprint-digest/blueprint-source selection rules live in the instance model only. Only the identity core (id, blueprint, created, phase, generation) is required, because a machine caught mid-create carries just that transitional subset; a fully materialized (ready/running) machine additionally carries the resolved fields and drives below. The running VM's identity and port live in a separate vm.json, not here. No $schema field is written pre-beta.

id.description: The machine id, <blueprint>-<n>: the blueprint name (identity) and the lowest-free non-negative number at create time.

blueprint.description: The blueprint's identity name (its declared name, else its file stem) — the id's stem and the name-selection key.

created.description: Creation timestamp, UTC ISO 8601 to the second (YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ).

phase.description: Lifecycle phase. The three transitional phases (creating/stopping/destroying) mark an operation in flight, reconciled at the next op.

generation.description: Operation generation: a monotonic counter bumped once per mutating operation, so an interrupted operation is detectable by phase and generation.

backend-id.description: The stable per-machine backend identity (reliquary-<id>), regenerated into the backend at each start.

blueprint-digest.description: sha256:<hex> over the resolved blueprint snapshot (cache paths excluded), so two machines of one blueprint share it and apply/start can detect blueprint drift.

blueprint-source.description: Absolute path of the blueprint file this machine resolved from, recorded for --blueprint selection scoping. Absent when the machine was created without a source path.

memory.description: Resolved guest memory in whole MiB.

boot.description: Resolved boot order: declared drive keys in order.

name.description: The blueprint's declared identity name, or null when it defaulted to the file stem.

description.description: The blueprint's human description, or null.

scripts.description: The blueprint's script label -> stem map.

backend-settings.description: The blueprint's per-backend settings sections, carried through verbatim.

drives.description: The resolved, enabled drives keyed by drive key. Each entry carries the drive's medium and slot plus the realized cache path (an image file, a host directory, or null for an empty removable slot).

driveState.description: One resolved drive. medium and slot are always present; controller is present for non-floppy drives; media names the resolved media (null in an empty removable slot) and materialize records how it is realized (new/difference/copy/use, null for an empty slot); size is present for a 'new' image; path is the cache location (or null for an empty removable slot).
